name: grok-studio
description: An agentic Roblox studio for Grok Bot: a Lead bot runs Designer (UI), Animator, Builder (Studio + Blender) and Coding bots that build a complete game from one prompt in your Roblox Studio - spec, Luau code, mobile UI, maps and models, animations, an automated playtest-and-fix loop, icon and thumbnails. One setup command creates the team and connects Studio, Blender and Figma.
